svg.title: Where the two supervisor-harness backends diverge
svg.desc: Host-delegated: the harness hands a work packet to Claude Code or Cursor, which report back. Autonomous: the harness calls a provider and runs tool rounds itself. Both meet in the same supervision code.

text.tspan: Both run the same supervision path. The difference is who calls the model; host-delegated, the harness is not in the model path at all.
its own tools, its own permission model
record the turn · assess drift · issue a directive · route the messages · verify
Details: docs/architecture.md, Where the two backends diverge
